newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Western primary aluminium '97 demand to rise 4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Western primary aluminium '97 demand to rise 4 pct.

text.p: Western World primary aluminium consumption is expected to rise significantly by 4.0 during 1997, the European Aluminium Association said in a quarterly report.
An EAA official said that a market analysis showed that consumption would rise to 18.29 million tonnes, after falling one percent to 17.58 million tonnes in 1996.
"It's an analysis not a political statement," the official said, adding that economic growth and restocking was expected to boost aluminium demand in the automotive, packaging and building sectors.
European primary aluminium production rose 2.1 percent to 3.25 million tonnes in 1996, the EAA report added, noting a slightly declining growth rate in the second half of the year.
